claims.statement: In Chicago Tom Allen and Jem Mace were matched for a $5,000 fight to come off May 20, 1876, with Barney Aaron acting for Allen and Harry Hill for Mace; a forfeit was put up.
claims.excerpt:
Was made here to-day between Tom Allen and
Jem Mace, to come off May 20, next

fights.excerpt: Jem Mace, to come off May 20, next
fights.notes: Planned bout; not yet fought. The Chicago Times account (528) says the match was made on Nov. 17, not Nov. 15 as this dateline says.
